gaps: DEMO ASSUMPTION (see prompts/process-expert.md): business-track LMS sessions 3-6 (market & customers, business model, key metrics, roadmap) have no real source data anywhere in this dataset - their descriptions are topical only, not grounded in actual figures/customers/roadmap items. This must be validated against the real LMS before removing the assume-it-exists behavior. Sessions 1-2 ARE grounded in real data (company_overview, products).

No Professional Mentor field exists anywhere in the Context Layer output - mentor assignment happens via manager intake (framework part F §13/14), a separate upstream step. No professional_mentor item was scheduled for anyone until that step supplies one.

No explicit interface map exists for Veridian teams (no source table lists which teams interface with which). Nothing in this employee's context identifies which specific teams AI Platform interfaces with, so no interface_contact meetings were scheduled.

AI Platform has 12 people (6+), so per framework part D §11 only the mandatory group intro was scheduled. role.core_collaboration doesn't name specific teammates, so no additional context-driven individual team_member follow-ups were added.

Week 1 has 7 load units against the 6-unit cap (framework part C §8) - unavoidable given this employee's real data: 3 Day-1-anchored people items (manager, buddy intro, office tour) + LMS session 1 (explicitly pinned to week 1) + 2 trainings genuinely due by day 7 + the systems bundle. None of these six components has room to move without either violating a real due date or the user's explicit week-1 placement for session 1. Flagged, not silently resolved.

The Engineering department overview (week 4) has no dedicated 'Trainer' role available in this dataset, so it defaults to the direct manager as facilitator per the stated fallback rule - not a specialized trainer.
This agent does not generate applied 'doing' work tickets (out of scope by design) - actual work assignments should come from the employee's manager/team backlog, not this plan.
